## About
K&G Mobile Tire Repair is a mobile tire service in Palo Alto. Instead of you waiting around at a tire store, our technicians come to your home or work and handle your tires while you get on with your day.
We install new and used tires, patch flats when it's safe to do so, check air pressure, rotation and balance, and help with a jump start or gas when you're stuck.
Our customers have rated us 4.9 from 109 Google reviews. If you need us, call or text and we'll get moving.

## Services
- New and used tire installation: We bring new or used tires to you and install them on site.
- Flat tire repair: If it's safe to do so, we repair your flat right where you are.
- Road side services: Need a jump start or gas? We can help with that too.
- General tire inspection: We check your tires' air pressure, rotation and balance.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need to bring my car somewhere?
A: No. We come to your home or workplace and do the work there.

Q: Can you fix my tire, or will I need a new one?
A: Our trained technicians look at the tire and repair it, or replace it if that's the better option.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, we're closed on Sunday.
